exception.needs: slot layer_cap_grant '<die lead>: <reason>' (pin-dense edge relays / stations only)

layer_defaults.closed_views: keep their own cap as slot view_cap; valid only while tools/hier_contract/child_lint.py passes at it (strap = cap + 1); re-route at M5 per m5_reroute_priority.json

changelog.change: provisional from r22ko4 e7 case (e6 21fdd3100 + qfd_io_collective M7 straps)
two-level hierarchy per slot (io_collective two-level with sub-slots; qfd_tile replicated cluster); seam_check spec; ctlm pending outline; tile target clock insertion
GLUE PLACEMENT: io_collective + qfd_tile are hardened clusters (glue inside); seams = die closure; die_closure section
migrated to opentallas.hier_contract.v1; deltas D1 (clock entry M6 face pin) and D2 (tile_nk W-face tree words) applied; relays = die_top_logic

D5: station/tap words 323 -> 509 bits (508 data + ready) (a/b/tap on qfd_cst_n/s, tap on qfd_tile_nk) = the RTL that closed: qfd_cst (ot_qwen_die_station a_d/b_d/t_d 508) and ot_qwen_rom_tile_nk ib 379 + ib_go 1 + xl 128; the b3r2 compressed instruction transport (TAP_BITS 325) is not in any RTL. D6: qfd_tile_nk signal_max_layer M6 -> M7 (die straps M8; M7 signals run between the tile M7 PG straps). Tile_nk outline HELD at 266.952 x 1291.656 (~60% util): the 52.68 um column channel holds the closed qfd_cst stations, and +21.4 um x 64 columns = +45 mm2 -> 866 > 858 mm2 reticle.

M5 tile layer contract (results/arch/hier_contract_1011/layer_usage_1012.md (coordinator decision, main f964f6b2d)): new tile routes cap signals AND PG at M5 (strap M6, pins M4/M5, keepout M6; M6 by layer_cap_grant only; die signals M6/M7 over tiles; M8/M9 die power/global). 1633 tile slots bumped (view_cap = closed view's own cap; 0 views INVALID: signals above their own cap; 0 already <= M5; 1633 need a pin re-plan off M6+); unchanged: 1537 cluster, 5 hard IP, 18 die-layer slots. Tool: tools/hier_contract/m5_layer_bump.py contracts
